description: Rename a Goal, set its Outcome or its estimate. Its ID, refs and Plan File stay the same, and it needs no Claim. To change a Goal's Tasks, claim it and use add_tasks, update_task or drop_task.

estimate.description: How long the whole Goal should take, such as '6h'; it covers the open Tasks that have no estimate of their own. An empty string removes it, so the Goal's estimate is the sum of its Tasks'.

outcome.description: The new Outcome; an empty string removes it.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

name: update_goal
title: Update Goal
